arxiv-2204-08357.title: Hybrid FSO/THz-based Backhaul Network for mmWave Terrestrial Communication
arxiv-2204-08357.creator: Praveen Kumar Singya 1 , , Behrooz Makki 2 , , Antonio D’Errico 3 , , and Mohamed-Slim Alouini 1
arxiv-2204-08357.description: Abstract In this work, a hybrid free-space optics (FSO)/ teraHertz (THz) based backhaul network is considered to provide high-data-rate reliable communication to the terrestrial mobile users (MUs) operating at millimeter-wave (mmWave) bands. The FSO link is affected by atmospheric turbulence and pointing error impairments. At the FSO receiver, both intensity-modulated direct detection and heterodyne detection techniques are considered.

arxiv-2206-12095.title: Leverage Ratio: An empirical study of the European banking system
arxiv-2206-12095.creator: Jatin Dhingra, Kartikeya Singh, Siddhartha P. Chakrabarty
arxiv-2206-12095.description: Abstract This paper empirically analyzes a dataset published by the European Banking Authority. Our main aim was to study how the Leverage Ratio is affected by adverse financial scenarios. This was be followed by observing how Leverage Ratio exposures are correlated to various other financial variables and how various regression techniques can be used to explain the correlation.

arxiv-2410-07960.title: Kirillov’s conjecture on Hecke–Grothendieck polynomials
arxiv-2410-07960.creator: Ben Brubaker, A. Suki Dasher, Michael Hu, Nupur Jain, Yifan Li, Yi Lin, Maria Mihaila, Van Tran, I. Deniz Ünel
arxiv-2410-07960.description: Abstract . We use algebraic methods in statistical mechanics to represent a multi-parameter class of polynomials in several variables as partition functions of a new family of solvable lattice models. The class of polynomials, defined by A. N. Kirillov, is derived from the largest class of divided difference operators satisfying the braid relations of Cartan type A A .

arxiv-2501-16626.title: Subject Representation Learning from EEG using Graph Convolutional Variational Autoencoders
arxiv-2501-16626.creator: Aditya Mishra, Ahnaf Mozib Samin, Ali Etemad, Javad Hashemi
arxiv-2501-16626.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Aditya Mishra, Ahnaf Mozib Samin, Ali Etemad, Javad Hashemi. We propose GC-VASE, a graph convolutional-based variational autoencoder that leverages contrastive learning for subject representation learning from EEG data. Our method successfully learns robust subject-specific latent representations using the split-latent space architecture tailored for subject identification. To enhance the model’s adaptability to unseen subjects without extensive retraining, we introduce an attention-based adapter network for fine-tuning, which reduces the computational cost of adapting the model to new subjects.

arxiv-2507-15041.title: Visibility vs. Engagement: How Two Indian News Websites Reported on LGBTQ+ Individuals and Communities during the Pandemic
arxiv-2507-15041.creator: Dhruvee Birla, Nazia Akhtar
arxiv-2507-15041.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Dhruvee Birla, Nazia Akhtar. In India, online news media outlets were an important source of information for people with digital access during the COVID–19 pandemic. In India, where “transgender” was legally recognised as a category only in 2014, and same–sex marriages are yet to be legalised, it becomes crucial to analyse whether and how they reported the lived realities of vulnerable LGBTQ+ communities during the pandemic.

arxiv-2507-21338.title: Autonomous Exploration with Terrestrial-Aerial Bimodal Vehicles
arxiv-2507-21338.creator: Yuman Gao, Ruibin Zhang, Tiancheng Lai, Yanjun Cao, Chao Xu, Fei Gao
arxiv-2507-21338.description: Abstract Terrestrial-aerial bimodal vehicles, which integrate the high mobility of aerial robots with the long endurance of ground robots, offer significant potential for autonomous exploration. Given the inherent energy and time constraints in practical exploration tasks, we present a hierarchical framework for the bimodal vehicle to utilize its flexible locomotion modalities for exploration.

arxiv-2602-21978.title: CxMP: A Linguistic Minimal-Pair Benchmark for Evaluating Constructional Understanding in Language Models
arxiv-2602-21978.creator: Miyu Oba Saku Sugawara
arxiv-2602-21978.description: Abstract Recent work has examined language models from a linguistic perspective to better understand how they acquire language. Most existing benchmarks focus on judging grammatical acceptability, whereas the ability to interpret meanings conveyed by grammatical forms has received much less attention.

pmc-10555332.title: THU619 Atypical Clinical Presentation Of Adrenal Hemorrhage
pmc-10555332.creator: Thayse Lozovoy Madsen-Barbosa, Fidini Hayati Antoni, Adline Ghazi
pmc-10555332.description: Disclosure: T.L. Madsen-Barbosa: None. F.H. Antoni: None. A. Ghazi: None. Introduction: Adrenal hemorrhage (AH) is an uncommon condition that is challenging to diagnose due to its nonspecific findings. We illustrate a case of AH that presented with acute clinical deterioration and had catecholamine overproduction.

pmc-10719842.title: Neuron pruning in temporal domain for energy efficient SNN processor design
pmc-10719842.creator: Dongwoo Lew, Hoyoung Tang, Jongsun Park
pmc-10719842.description: Recently, the accuracy of spike neural network (SNN) has been significantly improved by deploying convolutional neural networks (CNN) and their parameters to SNN. The deep convolutional SNNs, however, suffer from large amounts of computations, which is the major bottleneck for energy efficient SNN processor design.

pmc-11405780.title: Lipoprotein metabolism mediates hematopoietic stem cell responses under acute anemic conditions
pmc-11405780.creator: Kiyoka Saito, Mark van der Garde, Terumasa Umemoto, Natsumi Miharada, Julia Sjöberg, Valgardur Sigurdsson, Haruki Shirozu, Shunsuke Kamei, Visnja Radulovic, Mitsuyoshi Suzuki, Satoshi Nakano, Stefan Lang, Jenny Hansson, Martin L Olsson, Takashi Minami, Gunnar Gouras, Johan Flygare, Kenichi Miharada
pmc-11405780.description: Hematopoietic stem cells (HSCs) react to various stress conditions. However, it is unclear whether and how HSCs respond to severe anemia. Here, we demonstrate that upon induction of acute anemia, HSCs rapidly proliferate and enhance their erythroid differentiation potential. In severe anemia, lipoprotein profiles largely change and the concentration of ApoE increases.

pmc-11495873.title: m6ATM: a deep learning framework for demystifying the m6A epitranscriptome with Nanopore long-read RNA-seq data
pmc-11495873.creator: Boyi Yu, Genta Nagae, Yutaka Midorikawa, Kenji Tatsuno, Bhaskar Dasgupta, Hiroyuki Aburatani, Hiroki Ueda
pmc-11495873.description: N6-methyladenosine (m6A) is one of the most abundant and well-known modifications in messenger RNAs since its discovery in the 1970s. Recent studies have demonstrated that m6A is involved in various biological processes, such as alternative splicing and RNA degradation, playing an important role in a variety of diseases.

pmc-12392009.title: Bixin from Bixa orellana L.: Analytical Method Validation, Physicochemical Characterization, and Selective Antifungal Activity against Candida spp.
pmc-12392009.creator: Deborah Fernandes Rodrigues, Marina Vieira, Marcel Alexandre Formaggio Moraes Júnior, Rodrigo Michelini Oliveira Thomasi, Ruben Dario Sinisterra Millán, Eliana Faria Garcia, Renê Oliveira Couto, William Gustavo Lima, Magna Cristina Paiva, Carlos Eduardo Matos Jensen
pmc-12392009.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Bixin is a lipophilic apocarotenoid abundant in the aril of Bixa orellana L. Widely used as a natural colorant in food, textile, and cosmetic industries, its pharmacological potential remains underexplored. This study aimed to extract and purify bixin, characterize its physicochemical properties, develop and validate an HPLC method for quantification, and evaluate its antifungal activity, cytotoxicity, and selectivity in vitro. Extraction was performed by Soxhlet using hexane and chloroform, followed by recrystallization in acetone.

pmc-12662562.title: Moderating effects of affective interventions on manic symptoms and quality of life: A cognitive improvement study based on patients with bipolar disorder
pmc-12662562.creator: Bingwei Zhang, Chao Li, Suilin Jia, Guangdong Chen
pmc-12662562.description: Background:Initially, psychotherapy was the primary treatment for bipolar disorder. However, with advances in biomedical research and the rapid efficacy of medications, psychosocial treatments have been increasingly overlooked. Despite evidence supporting bipolar disorder as a “biological disease,” psychotherapy remains essential as an adjunct to medication and other treatments, including emotional interventions.

pmc-12999420.title: A systematic audit of transparency and validation disclosure in commercial veterinary artificial intelligence
pmc-12999420.creator: David Brundage
pmc-12999420.description: ObjectiveTo systematically identify the commercial market for clinical artificial intelligence (AI) products in veterinary medicine and audit their public documentation for transparency using a standardized, evidence-based instrument.MethodsA cross-sectional systematic audit of commercial AI tools was completed via a multi-channel search. Inclusion criteria required commercially available products with explicit AI claims and clinical functionality; administrative and direct-to-consumer tools were excluded.

pmc-13045359.title: Using Machine Learning to Analyze the Predictors of Life Satisfaction: Focus on Lifestyle Attitudes and Psychological Factors
pmc-13045359.creator: Furkan Bahadir Alptekin, Ebrar Torlak, Özge Asik, Betul Karaaslan, Ebru Turgal, Huseyin Sehit Burhan, Hasan Mervan Aytac, Oya Guclu
pmc-13045359.description: ObjectivesLife satisfaction is an essential indicator of quality of life, and enhancing it can contribute to individual well‐being strategies. Because it is a complex concept, a comprehensive approach is needed to address it effectively. Machine learning offers a unique statistical opportunity to address this challenge effectively.

pmc-13518963.title: How coastal resilience emerges
pmc-13518963.creator: Unknown
pmc-13518963.description: As climate change accelerates and pressures on coastal systems intensify, understanding coastal resilience is becoming as important as understanding the hazards themselves. Few environments are shaped by the interaction of natural and human influences as profoundly as coastal zones. They are highly sensitive to sea level rise, high-energy storms, and erosional processes that alter sediment supply and coastal dynamics.

pmc-13682406.title: Single-cell transcriptomic atlas uncovers immune/structural lineage remodeling and fibrosis in Klebsiella pneumoniae-infected porcine lungs
pmc-13682406.creator: Wei Wang, Junhui Zhu, Sibo Zhu, Changyou Xia, Xuan Jiang, Chuntong Bao, Ziheng Li, Rining Zhu, Tong Wu, Nan Zhang, Qila Sa, Shaopeng Wei, Brendon Scicluna, Fengyang Li, Liancheng Lei, Na Li
pmc-13682406.description: Klebsiella pneumoniae (KP) is a predominant pathogen in respiratory infections, whose widespread antibiotic resistance poses severe public health risks and economic burdens. As the primary target of KP infection, the lung contains diverse immune cells, while pulmonary cellular responses to KP remain poorly understood.
